ppi_focus: Rear subframe mounts, trunk-floor spot welds and differential ears on a lift, checking for cracking, tearing or prior weld repair.
Underside corrosion (salt-state car): rockers, jacking points, floors, subframe, brake and fuel lines.
Cooling system: water pump play, radiator and expansion tank plastic, hoses, thermostat, fan clutch; coolant pressure test.
Oil leaks: oil filter housing gasket, valve cover, rear main seal (relevant given the recent transmission removal).
Clutch engagement height, slip test, transmission mounts and shift feel after the throwout bearing job; differential mount and bushings.
Dinan tune and exhaust: scan for codes and readiness monitors, verify catalytic converters present, record EO labels for CA smog.
VANOS rattle or performance, and any S52 cold-start noises.
Soft top: frame, fabric, rear window, seals and drains; water-leak check of the footwells and trunk.
Tire date codes and tread; rear trailing-arm bushings, shocks and upper mounts.
Body: paint meter reading for respray or accident evidence; window regulators; A/C performance after the recent service.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a VIN with a clean CARFAX showing one or two owners, plus trunk-floor and underside photos showing no cracking or rust.
Up: receipts for cooling-system work, the throwout bearing/clutch job and fluid services, plus documented CARB EO numbers for the tune and exhaust.
Down: any rear subframe cracking, significant underside rust, more than two owners, or a reported accident.
Down: no EO coverage for the Dinan software or exhaust and no stock parts available, making CA registration costly or infeasible.
evidence.mission_note: A manual S52 Z3 M in a desirable colour combination at a below-mid price fits the enthusiast-keeper brief and sits within budget. Its suitability as a year-round rain daily, and as a California registration, depends on the unverified top, rear structure, rust and Dinan smog paperwork.
evidence.rationale: The photos establish a genuine 1998 M Roadster with a manual gearbox, the S52 engine, 64,745 miles on the odometer and an Arctic Silver over Imola Red two-tone interior. They also show a clean cabin and engine bay with no visible warning lights. The clean title, clean CARFAX and recent A/C, brake and throwout-bearing work are dealer claims only: no VIN, report or invoice is provided. Observed issues are non-stock Dinan engine modifications and the car's location in a salt state. Only the throttle body shows a CARB EO label; the tune and exhaust EO status is unknown, which bears directly on CA smog. The two critical items for this model, rear subframe/trunk-floor condition and cooling-system history, are both missing; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply to this S52 car. The price of $16,800 sits below the $18,494 fair-value mid and inside the comp band. Owner count, tire dates and soft-top condition remain open.
evidence.next_action: Message N&N Auto Outlet for the VIN, the CARFAX, invoices for the claimed maintenance, Dinan EO documentation, and trunk-floor/underside photos, and confirm they will allow a mobile PPI on a lift before any deposit.
